Install: `uv tool install miseenplace-cli` (commands: `miseenplace`, `mep`). Try it: `uvx --from miseenplace-cli mep demo`.

`mep` now remembers three kinds of things, and finds the right ones for the task at hand: lessons (how to behave), facts (what is true) and recipes (how to do something).

## Highlights

- `mep fact` keeps facts with their history: a new value supersedes the old one instead of overwriting it, `forget` records why, stale facts are listed by `fact check`, secret-looking values are refused, and facts taken from chat are marked untrusted.
- `mep recipe` keeps named procedures with `{placeholders}`. New or changed recipes are proposed until you approve them; `show --set server=koyal` fills them in; mep never runs the steps.
- `mep recall "stop koyal"` returns only the relevant lessons, facts and recipes, within a character budget. Keyword ranking (BM25) with typo matching, pure Python, no model and no embeddings.
- `mep today` no longer shows a thread as waiting on you when the last message is just "ok" or "thanks" after your reply.

## Try it

```bash
uv tool upgrade miseenplace-cli
mep fact add prod-runs-on "EC2" --source "me"
mep recall "where does prod run"
```

Full list of changes: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/ankitkpandey1/miseenplace/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
